verdict.rationale: Accounts-payable automation is a fair question for a business payments account, so the axis applies. The evidence covers sending payments, batch transfers and statements, but nothing on invoice capture, purchase-order matching, GL coding or approval routing. Batch payment APIs are only adjacent building blocks for paying vendors, not the requested invoice-to-PO workflow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have vendor invoices automatically matched to purchase orders, coded, and routed for payment
